description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-E (%) performance across three category groups under four distinct training conditions. The horizontal axis displays the categories; the first label is obscured by a solid grey rectangle, while the subsequent labels are "LLaMA-2-13B" and "LLaMA-2-70B". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "CoLeG-E (%)", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to just above 50, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, where each category contains a cluster of four bars arranged side-by-side. Based on the legend, these components represent: "no SFT" (light blue with top-left to bottom-right diagonal white stripes), "+ SFT on $D_0$" (light orange with horizontal white stripes), "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" (light purple with bottom-left to top-right diagonal white stripes), and "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" (solid light pink). Within each group, the bars are sorted in ascending order of height from left to right. In the first group with the obscured label, values range from the shortest bar in the chart at approximately 4% for "no SFT" to about 30% for the solid pink bar. For "LLaMA-2-13B", values start at roughly 8.5% and rise to 39%. The "LLaMA-2-70B" group contains the highest values, beginning at approximately 26.5% and culminating in the tallest bar in the chart at roughly 50.5% for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$". Aside from the grey rectangle masking the first horizontal axis label, there are no other specific visual emphases or annotations.
